fusions.name: Twin Tines
fusions.desc: Looses 2 bites in a wide spread, each of which deals 7 damage. You heal for 10% of the damage dealt. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Branching Path
fusions.desc: You rush up to 5 tiles to the first enemy ahead and strike it for 12 damage. The blow then forks to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 100% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Turned Aside
fusions.desc: Turns afflictions back on whoever inflicts them: each debuff laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to its source instead, for 9 seconds. You move 20% faster for 4s after using it.

fusions.name: Parting Shot
fusions.desc: Each weapon strike also sends a bolt of lightning to the nearest other enemy within 6.5 tiles, dealing 5 damage. Once every 6 seconds.
